Hello:) Sending an invitation for those feeling burnt out or in need of a reset. From October 16th-19th, I will be hosting a 4-day retreat in Santa Fe, New Mexico.

Hi :wave::skin-tone-2: ,
*I’am UX/UI designer.* Complex products deserve clear, confident interfaces. *Over the last 3.5 years,* I’ve specialized in dashboards, admin panels, and data‑heavy web & mobile apps, turning dense workflows into simple, scalable experiences. I’m excited to bring that focus to your team as a product designer.

*What I offer:*
• End‑to‑end product design. From zero‑to‑one definition through delivery, I’ve taken products from brief to shipped features — structuring information architecture, mapping flows, and validating solutions with rapid prototypes.
• Design systems at speed. I build component libraries with design tokens to keep typography, color, and spacing consistent across platforms, accelerating delivery and reducing engineering churn.
• Deep data UI expertise. I design sortable tables, filters, permissions, and real‑time states that make complex operations (and edge cases) intuitive for power users.
• AI‑accelerated craft. I use ChatGPT for ideation and microcopy exploration and Midjourney for visual directions and marketing imagery—helping teams explore more options, faster, without sacrificing quality.
• Web3 product context. I’ve designed DeFi tools — including a DEX, launchpad, and wallet manager — where clarity, trust, and error‑prevention are mission‑critical.
*How I work:*
• Partner closely with PMs/engineers to define problems, trade‑offs, and success criteria.
• Translate complex requirements into simple patterns that scale across features.
• Ship in iterative slices, using feedback and product metrics to refine.
• Keep typography, color, and composition tight — so the interface looks great and reads instantly.
I’d love to discuss how my background in systems‑driven UI and data‑rich products can help your team move faster with more confidence.

My contacts: <https://www.linkedin.com/in/antonkunak/|Linkedin>, <https://t.me/anton_kunak|Telegram>, <mailto:anton.uxui@gmail.com|Email>.
